crossRefs.note: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
Who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves…
I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all…
Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

translations.web: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
translations.bsb: Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
translations.kjv: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
translations.asv: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.
